notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
The badge system was removed

Minor improvements were made to the tutorial and bootstrap system

Added 12 Level 1 weapons

Slightly balance the values of all weapons

notes.title: BetaVersion
notes.content:
- Fixed a Bug in determining element alerts in the settlement interface

Reduced overall monster health in late stages

Restored end damage surge

Improved landing materials and enemy hunting in Hell

notes.title: Beta1.32
notes.content:
Fixed a Bug where repel would open coroutines twice

Implemented sweeping monsters no longer eat control

Optimized repel performance

Added control effects that decay with distance

Removed end damage surge

Small redo of late events

Reduced the number of overall monsters in late stages

Increased the probability of cake dropping

Introduction and tutorial tips have been added

Fixed the decapitation Bug

notes.title: Beta1.32
notes.content:
Fixed the elemental Power Bug in weapon synthesis
Fixed a click blocking Bug in store gear
Removed the quest system and the strategy system
Added a hint to the settlement interface
A mini-remake of the mileage system
